title: Can Scientific Claims Be Removed from Large Language Models? A Systematic Evaluation of Claim-Level Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2608.20960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models (LMs) are trained on static scientific corpora, whereas scientific knowledge continuously evolves through correction and revision. Scientific claims encoded within these models may later become retracted, disproven, or updated by subsequent research, creating the risk of disseminating outdated information in scientific workflows. This creates a need for LMs to forget obsolete scientific claims. Machine unlearning offers a promising solution by enabling knowledge removal while maintaining overall model utility. Existing studies primarily investigate instance-level forgetting; however, scientific claims introduce additional challenges because they are interconnected, and continually evolving. To address this gap, we introduce the task of Scientific Claim Unlearning and present a new benchmark, SciUnlearn. translated_title: 科学主张能否从大型语言模型中移除？主张级机器遗忘的系统性评估
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LMs）在静态科学语料库上训练，而科学知识通过修正和修订不断演进。这些模型中编码的科学主张可能随后被后续研究撤回、推翻或更新，从而在科学工作流程中传播过时信息的风险。这要求语言模型能够遗忘过时的科学主张。机器遗忘提供了一种有前景的解决方案，能够在保持模型整体效用的同时实现知识移除。现有研究主要关注实例级遗忘；然而，科学主张因相互关联且不断演进，带来了额外挑战。为填补这一空白，我们引入了科学主张遗忘任务，并提出了新基准SciUnlearn。我们表明，当前的遗忘方法无法有效消除主张级知识，且往往只能实现部分效果。
tldr: 本文首次系统评估了大型语言模型在科学主张层面的机器遗忘能力，并提出了新基准SciUnlearn，揭示现有方法在移除相互关联且动态演进的科学知识方面存在显著不足。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates claim-level unlearning in large language models for scientific knowledge, introducing the SciUnlearn benchmark and revealing that existing methods struggle to effectively remove interconnected and evolving scientific claims.
